data.name: Mehsood
data.gender_notes: Mehsood is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘Asud, meaning 'to win' or 'to be victorious'. Mehsood signifies triumph and success in the face of adversity. The name Mehsood carries the meaning “Victorious” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mehsood usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the spiritual victory achieved through adherence to the teachings of Islam.
data.etymology: Mehsood belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mehsood total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: محسود
in_arabic.long_meaning: المحسود هو الشخص الذي يتمناه الناس ويأملون في وجوده، وهو مشتق من الجذر العربي 'حَسَدَ' الذي يعني الرغبة في الشيء. وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم ذكر الحَسَد في سياقات مختلفة، مما يعطي هذا الاسم عمقًا دينيًا وثقافيًا كبيرًا في التقاليد الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: محسود
in_urdu.meaning: وہ شخص جس کی ہر کسی خواہش کرتا ہے، مرغوب شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام 'محسود' عربی زبان کے جذر 'حَسَدَ' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے کسی چیز کی خواہش کرنا۔ یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں خاصی اہمیت رکھتا ہے، کیونکہ یہ اس شخص کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہے جسے لوگ پسند کرتے ہیں اور اس کی تعریف کرتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: महसूद
in_hindi.meaning: जिसकी सब इच्छा करते हैं, इच्छित व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: महसूद नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जहां इसका अर्थ है किसी वस्तु की इच्छा करना। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी प्रचलित है, जहां यह उस व्यक्ति को संदर्भित करता है जो लोगों की इच्छाओं और अपेक्षाओं को पूरा करता है।

in_english.name: Mehsood
in_english.meaning: Desired person, one whose presence is wished for
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mehsood originates from the Arabic root 'حَسَدَ' (hasede), meaning to wish or desire. In Islamic tradition, this name signifies a person who is highly regarded and whose presence is deeply desired by others. It reflects positive attributes such as being cherished and valued within the community. Historically, names derived from this root have been used to denote individuals of great spiritual or social significance.
